dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, healthcare is FREE in Sumeru?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, not right now. Thanks for asking, though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Eating the street food on every corner has never sounded so tempting!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your stomach is going to punish you for that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If so, Paimon'll go see a doctor and get treated — it's all for free! It'd be a waste not to take advantage of this, don't you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *gasp* Oh no! So no more delicious food, then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That, plus the doctor would make you take the most bitter-tasting medicine ever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: O—Okay... Maybe Paimon needs to reconsider this idea...

choices.text: The treatment would likely include a restricted diet.
